mapper.select: SELECT h.tenant_id,h.collection_id,h.owner_project_id,h.title,h.current_version,h.created_by,h.created_at,h.classification,h.revision,h.updated_at FROM collection_head h WHERE h.collection_id=#{collectionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT c.tenant_id,c.collection_version,c.collection_id,c.purpose,c.manifest,c.content_sha256,c.schema_version,c.schema_manifest_sha256, c.created_by,c.created_at,c.classification,v.content_sha256 AS registered_sha256,v.owner_project_id AS registered_project_id FROM collection_version c JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND v.version_id=c.collection_version AND v.entity_kind='COLLECTION_VERSION'
mapper.select: WHERE c.collection_id=#{collectionId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,c.collection_version DESC

SELECT p.tenant_id,p.source_version,p.parse_version,p.content_sha256,p.parse_status, v.content_sha256 AS registered_sha256,v.owner_project_id AS registered_project_id FROM parse_version p JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND v.version_id=p.parse_version AND v.entity_kind='PARSE_VERSION' WHERE p.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND p.parse_version=#{parseVersion} FOR UPDATE

JOIN collection_head h ON h.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND h.collection_id=c.collection_id WHERE (h.owner_project_id IS NULL OR h.owner_project_id=#{projectId}) AND c.purpose='TASK_CREATION' ORDER BY c.collection_version LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.tenant_id,m.collection_version,m.source_version,m.parse_version,m.created_by,m.created_at,m.classification FROM collection_member m WHERE m.collection_version=#{versionId} ORDER BY m.source_version,m.parse_version LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE o.subject_id=#{userId} AND o.operation_name=#{operationName} AND o.idempotency_key=#{key}
